# Weight Sensitivity Analysis - Employer Verification

*Generated by `app/weight_sensitivity_analysis.py` - do not edit by hand; re-run the script instead.*

- **Dataset:** `data\final_realistic_dataset.csv`
- **Rows:** 1514 (legitimate: 978, fraudulent: 536)
- **ML probability source:** trained model (`final_model_v2.pkl`)
- **Decision cut-off:** score >= 45 -> legitimate (this experiment only)
- **Scope:** all rows are scored with a model that was trained on part of them, so these figures are an *in-sample sensitivity study*. Held-out results are produced by `notebooks/threshold_analysis.py`.
- **Fraud Acceptance Rate** = fraudulent employers scored as legitimate / all fraudulent (= 1 - Fraud Recall).

## Experiment 1 - predefined weight profiles

| Profile | Weights (ML/Reg/Rep/Web) | Accuracy | Precision | Recall | F1-Score | Fraud Recall | Fraud Acceptance Rate |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Proposed Baseline | 0.40 / 0.30 / 0.20 / 0.10 | 87.2% | 89.4% | 90.9% | 90.2% | 80.4% | 19.6% |
| ML-Dominant | 0.70 / 0.10 / 0.10 / 0.10 | 93.6% | 94.5% | 95.6% | 95.1% | 89.9% | 10.1% |
| Registry-Heavy | 0.20 / 0.60 / 0.10 / 0.10 | 72.9% | 74.7% | 87.9% | 80.8% | 45.5% | 54.5% |
| Equal Weights | 0.25 / 0.25 / 0.25 / 0.25 | 84.5% | 87.1% | 89.3% | 88.2% | 75.9% | 24.1% |
| Reputation-Ignored | 0.50 / 0.40 / 0.00 / 0.10 | 78.7% | 76.5% | 96.7% | 85.4% | 45.7% | 54.3% |

Proposed baseline (0.40/0.30/0.20/0.10): accuracy 87.2%, F1 90.2%, fraud recall 80.4%.

## How to read this
- The proposed baseline is kept as the production weighting for explainability: official registration is the one evidence source a job seeker can verify independently.
- The measured cost of that choice is the gap to the grid-search best above.
- Registry-heavy and reputation-ignored profiles give the weakest fraud recall.
- Part of this dataset simulates scam behaviour; the figures show *relative* differences between weightings, not field accuracy.
